item_key_vault.description: A green-crusted key, cold to the touch.

item_raft.description: A lashed-together raft, small enough to carry and big enough to cross a lake.

item_shard_courage.description: A warm golden shard, one piece of the broken Triad.

item_shard_wisdom.name: Shard of Wisdom
item_shard_wisdom.description: A cool blue shard, one piece of the broken Triad.
